name: qa-desktop
description: Desktop application testing across Windows (FlaUI, WinAppDriver - direct or Appium-invoked), Linux (AT-SPI), Electron (Playwright _electron API, incl. Spectron migration), and Qt (QtTest framework), with the driver decision table and test-review hazard checklist in desktop-test-strategy-reference, plus the desktop-test-author agent that detects the driver, scaffolds a fresh test project when none exists, and authors per-flow tests (macOS XCTest lives in qa-mobile's xcuitest-suite)
